title: TEST The Greyfield Ridge Camp
hook: In 1971, three climbers camped on Greyfield Ridge. By morning, the camp was empty.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Rescuers found the tent standing in fresh snow, with nobody inside.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The temperature that night was minus twenty, cold enough to kill in hours.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Their footprints led calmly downhill, toward the dark treeline.

beats.label: THE REPORT
beats.line: A diary mentioned strange lights, and the official report is still classified.

end.line: So what really happened on Greyfield Ridge?

description: Fictional test case for the paper case-file engine (not a real event).

facts.claim: Fictional test case, not a real event.
